create_frozen_learner: create a FrozenLearner that wraps an acme learner and ignores step calls to freeze training
run_frozen_learner: run the wrapped learner for a given number of steps using the FrozenLearner run method
save_frozen_learner: save the wrapped learner state by calling save on the FrozenLearner instance
restore_frozen_learner: restore the wrapped learner from a saved state using the FrozenLearner restore method
get_variables_frozen_learner: get named variables from the wrapped learner using the FrozenLearner get_variables method
